title: 台北迪化污水處理廠~Taipei Dihua Sewage Treatment Plant
focus: 都市半地下污水廠的水線與臭氣介面~Liquid treatment and odor interfaces in a semi-underground urban plant
summary: 以迪化的都市整合廠為例，沿沉澱、深槽曝氣、污泥與回收水觀察。每個污染物流都需對應量測點，不能只看地上公園景觀。~Use Dihua as an urban integrated plant, following settling, deep-tank aeration, sludge and recycled water. Every pollutant stream needs a measurement point beyond the park landscape.

units.title: 都市污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Urban wastewater entry: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「都市污水入口」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at urban wastewater entry.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「都市污水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for urban wastewater entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「都市污水入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the urban wastewater entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 雙層沉澱面積辨識：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Double-deck settling area: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「雙層沉澱面積辨識」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at double-deck settling area.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「雙層沉澱面積辨識」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for double-deck settling area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「雙層沉澱面積辨識」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the double-deck settling area measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 深槽有效容積：水力停留時間~Deep-tank active volume: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「深槽有效容積」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at deep-tank active volume.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「深槽有效容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for deep-tank active volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「深槽有效容積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the deep-tank active volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 階段進水生物負荷：食微比與生物量庫存~Staged-feed biological load: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory
units.mechanism: 食微比比較每天有機負荷與池內生物固體庫存；BOD、COD、MLSS與MLVSS的基準不得混用。本單元在「階段進水生物負荷」觀察此因果關係。~F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at staged-feed biological load.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. Formula F/M=QS/(VX); substitution 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Boundary: Nominal completely mixed ratio; nonbiodegradable fractions and temperature are excluded.
units.verify: 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「階段進水生物負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for staged-feed biological load; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: MLSS與活性微生物量完全等同。~MLSS is exactly equal to active microbial mass.
units.practice: 先點選「階段進水生物負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。與基準 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the staged-feed biological load measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Compare with baseline 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回流排泥固體帳：污泥齡與固體流失~Return/waste sludge balance: Sludge age and solids losses
units.mechanism: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「回流排泥固體帳」觀察此因果關係。~SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at return/waste sludge balance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
units.verify: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「回流排泥固體帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for return/waste sludge balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 不排剩餘污泥就代表沒有生物固體損失。~No intentional wasting means no biomass loss.
units.practice: 先點選「回流排泥固體帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the return/waste sludge balance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 深槽曝氣功率：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Deep-tank aeration power: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「深槽曝氣功率」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at deep-tank aeration power.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「深槽曝氣功率」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for deep-tank aeration power; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「深槽曝氣功率」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the deep-tank aeration power measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 出水質量驗證：去除效率與質量去向~Effluent mass verification: Removal efficiency and mass destination
units.mechanism: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「出水質量驗證」觀察此因果關係。~Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at effluent mass verification.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
units.verify: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「出水質量驗證」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for effluent mass verification; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看不到的污染物代表已完全被破壞。~An invisible pollutant has been completely destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「出水質量驗證」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the effluent mass verification measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 污泥與臭氣介面：乾固體與含水率~Sludge/odor interface: Dry solids and moisture
units.mechanism: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「污泥與臭氣介面」觀察此因果關係。~Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sludge/odor interface.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
units.verify: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「污泥與臭氣介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sludge/odor interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。~All wet-mass reduction during dewatering is destroyed pollution.
units.practice: 先點選「污泥與臭氣介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sludge/odor interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回收水用途：回用水混合與需求配對~Recycled-water use: Reuse blending and demand matching
units.mechanism: 混合濃度由各水流的質量加權，而不是簡單平均；不同用途的需求與品質應分別核對。本單元在「回收水用途」觀察此因果關係。~Blended concentration is mass weighted rather than a simple average; quality and demand must be checked separately for each reuse. Examine this relationship at recycled-water use.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
units.verify: 檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「回收水用途」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for recycled-water use; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 兩股不同流量的濃度總可直接取平均。~Concentrations of unequal flows can always be averaged directly.
units.practice: 先點選「回收水用途」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the recycled-water use measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 地下空間感測維護：感測器偏移校正~Underground-space instrumentation: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「地下空間感測維護」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at underground-space instrumentation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「地下空間感測維護」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for underground-space instrumentation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「地下空間感測維護」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the underground-space instrumentation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: 臺北官方介紹迪化採雙層沉澱池、深槽階段曝氣二級生物處理與半地下配置，另設回收水處理。~Taipei documents double-deck settling, deep-tank staged aeration for secondary biological treatment and a semi-underground layout with recycled-water treatment.

單元2變量實驗：只把面積加至400 m²~Unit2 changed-input experiment: increase only area to400 m²
單元3基準：深槽有效容積~Unit3 baseline: deep-tank active volume
單元3變量實驗：只把有效容積改成600 m³~Unit3 changed-input experiment: change only effective volume to600 m³
單元4基準：階段進水生物負荷~Unit4 baseline: staged-feed biological load
單元4變量實驗：只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³~Unit4 changed-input experiment: reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³
單元5基準：回流排泥固體帳~Unit5 baseline: return/waste sludge balance
單元5變量實驗：只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d~Unit5 changed-input experiment: increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d
單元6基準：深槽曝氣功率~Unit6 baseline: deep-tank aeration power
單元6變量實驗：只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh~Unit6 changed-input experiment: reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh
單元7基準：出水質量驗證~Unit7 baseline: effluent mass verification
單元7變量實驗：只把出水改成60 mg/L~Unit7 changed-input experiment: change only effluent to60 mg/L
單元8基準：污泥與臭氣介面~Unit8 baseline: sludge/odor interface
單元8變量實驗：只把固體分率提高到0.20~Unit8 changed-input experiment: increase only solids fraction to0.20
單元9基準：回收水用途~Unit9 baseline: recycled-water use
單元9變量實驗：只把Q2改成40 m³/h~Unit9 changed-input experiment: change only Q2 to40 m³/h
單元10基準：地下空間感測維護~Unit10 baseline: underground-space instrumentation
單元10變量實驗：只把樣品原讀值改成16.2~Unit10 changed-input experiment: change only raw sample to16.2
